editorial_review_row.author: NAFT Editorial
editorial_review_row.content: Exante is an MFSA/FCA/CySEC-regulated multi-asset platform scoring 7.4/10 from NAFT in 2026. Direct Market Access to 50+ exchanges with 50,000+ instruments. Premium positioning with $10,000 minimum. Real stocks, bonds, ETFs, options, and futures — not CFDs. Four regulatory licences. Best for sophisticated investors and portfolio managers needing global multi-exchange access from a single regulated platform.
